chapters.caption: Get the buildstyle: clone the repository
In ATU: File › Open › Project…
Select OSS_MPBF_01.fsp
Compile: the Build Style Log reports success
View › Data Management › Input Geometry Files
Load… and select an STL file
Import geometry: layer thickness 30 µm
The hatch plate is a build part, Part (solid)
Exposure Preview › Manage Profiles…: default is read-only
Duplicate… it and name the copy
Assign Profiles…: the copy for the part
Platform Parameter: the same profile
Execute in the toolbar
Layer range: bottom to top layer, then OK
Build: the Exposure Preview shows the layers
Volume hatch of layer 50: meander lines
Open Profile › your profile
Hatching › Volume: set the pattern to Chessboard
Execute and OK again
Rebuilt: chessboard hatch
Export: Execute once more
Tick Export Data and keep a filter, here LSR
Select Export Target…: file name of the package
OK: build and write the package
One ZIP: toolpath, parameters, build job image
Project Explorer › main › param_groups.js
Parameters with min, max and default value
Where the code is
